customer_updates.name: Parag Kashelkar
customer_updates.text: The true photographer with a great heritage. It's more of nostalgia for us. It's probably one of the largest photo studios in Mumbai. Has old art deco interiors. All black and white photos 50s hindi filmstars displayed here, are clicked by the owner Vimal Thakker s father. All my family members have their memories since childhood clicked here. He has a treadmark halo behind a portrait photo. My mama Vasant Argade used to keep his accounts in his spare time. I remember visiting this place 55 years ago. He is around since 80 plus years. It's an experience to get your photo clicked here. It's a part of Bombay heritage.

featured_reviews.name: SOMANATH PADHI
featured_reviews.review_text:
We had a truly wonderful experience with Poonam Studio. From the very beginning, their team was professional, attentive, and committed to ensuring that every moment of our journey was beautifully captured. We opted for their complete package of photography and videography, covering our pre-wedding events as well as all marriage rituals, and we couldn’t be more happier with the results.

The photographers and videographers were not only skilled but also very approachable, making us feel comfortable throughout. They blended creativity with precision, ensuring that candid moments, traditional rituals, and emotional highlights were all documented with elegance. The final output reflected their dedication—high-quality photos and videos that allow us to relive our special days with joy.

What stood out most was their ability to balance professionalism with a personal touch. They understood our preferences, accommodated our requests, and delivered everything on time without compromising on quality. For couples looking for a reliable studio that values both artistry and client satisfaction, Poonam Studio is an excellent choice.

We wholeheartedly recommend them to anyone seeking comprehensive wedding coverage. Their work speaks for itself, and we are grateful for the memories they have preserved for us.

featured_reviews.name: Vivek Vetal
featured_reviews.review_text:
Extremely Disappointed – Not Worth the Price or the Wait
I had a very disappointing experience with this photographer. Despite charging a premium price, the quality of the photos was shockingly subpar—poor lighting, awkward angles, and lack of editing finesse. What’s worse, I was promised delivery within 2 days, but I had to chase them for an entire week before I finally received the photos. Communication was minimal, and there was no apology or explanation for the delay. I expected professionalism and quality for the amount I paid, but sadly, this was far from it. I would not recommend their services unless you’re okay with overpaying for mediocre work and unreliable timelines
